_comment: WORLD Stormwood table, row stormwood_glass_for_bryn. The rod crews' shelter is the existing Rodline workshop (rodline_workshop, open work bay). One world-scoped delivery of ordinary Stormglass and Conductor Vine to Warden-Elect Bryn repairs it; inspecting the repaired supplies at its bay completes the chain, and the bay becomes a safe care point with one creature bed under its roof. Offsets are world-axis metres from `at`, the care point in front of the arch. The drained rod is dressing only: no rod safe radius, no Surge rod flag and no Calm multiplier (Rodline Post is already a Surge safe zone and Conductor Run has no rod flag).

care.label: Rest at the rod crews' shelter
